description_for_model: Autonomous non-custodial investment mandate agent for tokenized equities (xStocks) on OKX X Layer (Chain ID 196). Provides real-time USDG spot pricing, autonomous portfolio drift rebalancing, dollar-cost averaging (DCA) schedules, emergency circuit breaker halts, and intent-to-sign calldata generation via OKX Exchange OS.
description_for_human: AI-native investment mandate agent for tokenized equities on OKX X Layer.

tools.name: meirei_xstock_quote
tools.description: Fetch real-time USDG pricing and unit allocations for tokenized equities on OKX X Layer.

amount_usdg.description: Allocation in USDG to compute share units for

tools.name: meirei_create_mandate
tools.description: Construct an autonomous onchain investment mandate on OKX X Layer Chain 196.

target_weights.description: Asset tickers mapped to target percentage weights (e.g. {"NVDAx": 60, "AAPLx": 40})

max_drawdown_pct.description: Drawdown threshold percentage for circuit breaker halt

tools.name: meirei_check_drift
tools.description: Calculate current portfolio asset weights against target mandate weights to evaluate rebalancing necessity.

wallet_address.description: EVM wallet address on X Layer

tools.name: meirei_execute_rebalance
tools.description: Formulate atomic rebalancing swap calldata via OKX Exchange OS router for client-side signing.

trades.description: List of trade diffs needed to realign portfolio

tools.name: meirei_circuit_breaker
tools.description: Evaluate 24h portfolio drawdown and trigger emergency circuit breaker hold if threshold breached.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Maximum allowable drawdown percentage before halt

tools.name: meirei_get_portfolio
tools.description: Query authentic on-chain USDG and xStock token balances on OKX X Layer (Chain 196).
